---
title: "Best supportive care — endpoint preparation"
format: html
---

- Time starts at randomization; follow-up runs to the data lock, no 182-day cap
- Cause-specific BSC hazard: death before BSC is censoring
- Composite: first of BSC or death; same-day BSC and death count as BSC

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "survival.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "06-best-supportive-care", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cohort <- read_parquet(here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"))
```

## Endpoint derivation

```{r}
#| label: derive-endpoint
#| include: false
endpoint <- derive_dated_event_endpoints(
  cohort,
  event_date_col = "bsc_date",
  event_indicator_col = "bsc",
  event_label = "BSC",
  data_lock = config$analysis$data_lock
) |>
  rename(
    bsc_origin_date = origin_date,
    bsc_follow_up_limit = follow_up_limit,
    bsc_extends_recorded_follow_up = extends_recorded_follow_up,
    bsc_after_follow_up_limit = after_follow_up_limit,
    bsc_event_or_censor_date = event_or_censor_date,
    event_bsc = event_first,
    event_death_before_bsc = event_death_before_first,
    event_bsc_or_death = event_composite,
    bsc_censor_reason = censor_reason,
    time_to_bsc_days = time_days,
    bsc_exclusion_reason = exclusion_reason,
    bsc_in_analysis = in_analysis
  ) |>
  mutate(
    bsc_censor_reason = replace_values(
      bsc_censor_reason,
      "event_observed" ~ "bsc_observed",
      "death_before_event" ~ "death_before_bsc"
    ),
    bsc_exclusion_reason = replace_values(
      bsc_exclusion_reason,
      "event_before_randomization" ~ "bsc_before_randomization"
    )
  )

stopifnot(
  all(endpoint$bsc_exclusion_reason %in% c(
    "included", "bsc_before_randomization", "no_positive_follow_up"
  )),
  all(endpoint$event_bsc_or_death ==
        endpoint$event_bsc + endpoint$event_death_before_bsc),
  all(endpoint$event_bsc_or_death >= endpoint$event_bsc),
  # The follow-up limit carries the data lock on the shifted date scale.
  all(endpoint$bsc_event_or_censor_date <= endpoint$bsc_follow_up_limit),
  all(endpoint$time_to_bsc_days <= endpoint$potential_follow_up_days),
  all(endpoint$data_lock == config$analysis$data_lock)
)
```

## Analysis dataset

```{r}
#| label: prepare-analysis-data
#| include: false
prepared <- endpoint |>
  filter(bsc_in_analysis) |>
  # The column order sets the MICE visit sequence; diagnosis is joined later.
  select(
    id, tx, time_to_bsc_days, event_bsc, event_death_before_bsc,
    event_bsc_or_death, ecog_fstcnt, stage_binary, lung, age, gender,
    albumin, bilirubin, c_reactive_protein, lactate_dehydrogenase
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(prepared) > 0L,
  all(prepared$time_to_bsc_days > 0)
)

endpoint_audit <- endpoint |>
  count(tx, bsc_exclusion_reason, name = "participants")

event_counts <- prepared |>
  summarise(
    participants = n(),
    bsc_events = sum(event_bsc),
    death_before_bsc = sum(event_death_before_bsc),
    composite_events = sum(event_bsc_or_death),
    censored_without_either = sum(event_bsc_or_death == 0),
    .by = tx
  )

write_parquet(endpoint, file.path(results_dir, "endpoint.parquet"))
write_parquet(prepared, file.path(results_dir, "prepared.parquet"))
write_parquet(endpoint_audit, file.path(results_dir, "endpoint-audit.parquet"))
write_parquet(event_counts, file.path(results_dir, "event-counts.parquet"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-bsc-endpoint-audit
#| tbl-cap: "BSC analysis population and exclusions"
#| echo: false
kable(endpoint_audit)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-bsc-event-counts
#| tbl-cap: "Observed BSC and competing death events by randomized group"
#| echo: false
kable(event_counts)
```
